Canonical source and remote-first runtime boundary

Status: owner decision, 2026-09-12. The Codex A/B implementation won and is the canonical casekit product baseline.

Source authority

  • Canonical working branch: codex/casekit-ab.
  • Canonical module path while this worktree is active: E:\AI_Workspace\Projects\Propria\Consignatio\repair-tool-kit-codex\repair-tool-kit.
  • The -codex suffix identifies the current Git worktree; it does not create a separate product.
  • Claude or another agent may propose additions later. Those changes are inputs for review against this baseline, not a competing source of truth and not authority to overwrite it.
  • The adjacent main worktree currently has unrelated history and active changes. Canonical status does not authorize a force merge, reset, bulk copy, or destructive replacement.

Runtime responsibility

PlaneRolePermitted dataDefault processing
Windows workstationDevelopment, tests, desktop control/review, configuration, and small explicit fixturesSource code, small frozen test fixtures, bounded cache/scratch, and user-selected temporary materialDevelopment probes only. No bulk corpus ingestion, extraction, indexing, transcription, OCR, or durable corpus retention.
Linux VPSProduction worker and service hostBounded in-flight cache/scratch plus service state; durable outputs are committed to remote storesDefault location for extraction, indexing, classification, OCR/transcription, deduplication computation, and other corpus-scale jobs.
Remote durable storageCorpus and lakehouse system of recordOriginals, immutable hashes/provenance, extraction packages, Parquet/Lance tables, and durable derivatives according to lifecycle policyData plane, not a workstation mirror. B2 is the intended migration target; adapters may address current R2 or other providers during transition.

Operating rules

  1. Production configuration must default to a remote worker endpoint and remote durable object storage. A missing production dependency fails closed; it must not silently fall back to bulk local processing.
  2. Local processing requires an explicit development/test mode, bounded input selection, bounded concurrency, memory/time limits, and project-contained runtime paths.
  3. Local fixture results validate developer behavior only. Linux production binaries and profiles have their own target-environment certification gates.
  4. Large selected files may be staged into VPS-local in-flight scratch or cache for work. They are not loaded wholesale into memory, Redis/Dragonfly, or the Windows workstation.
  5. Queues and hot coordination state may use Dragonfly on the VPS; durable job state, provenance, source bytes, and extraction packages must survive queue-cache eviction.
  6. The workstation may request, monitor, pause, review, and approve work. Production workers return structured progress and errors rather than requiring the desktop to remain the execution host.
  7. Secrets and provider credentials stay in the appropriate service environment or credential store. They do not enter extraction packages, command display strings, logs, or Git.

Canonical promotion procedure

The current canonical branch has no merge base with main. Promotion is therefore an integration task, not an ordinary merge. Before moving it into the main Consignatio checkout:

  1. Freeze and verify this module with tests, hashes, and an inventory.
  2. Inventory active main-worktree files and identify additions that must be reviewed rather than overwritten.
  3. Create an explicit path-level integration plan: canonical file, incoming file, decision, and verification for every collision.
  4. Copy or replay only approved paths into a clean integration branch, preserve provenance, and run the complete validation suite.
  5. Change the physical canonical path only after owner review. Until then, this document and branch identify product authority.

Near-term implementation consequence

The next backend slices must make the boundary executable: platform-qualified engine profiles, a remote-worker configuration model, fail-closed environment validation, bounded work requests, and extraction-package provenance. UI expansion, corpus-scale local execution, and evidence-candidate review are not prerequisites for that backend foundation.
